sequences.name: a desk places what office panes hold; an office window places what the desk holds
one-window off: nothing is evicted anywhere
two office windows trade a session while the desk keeps it

evictions.name: evictions handed the whole registry never names a remote either
a taker that is not in the list (a window being made)
a remote taker that is not in the list

holders.name: the holder of a session is an office window, never the desk
a session only the desk has placed is held by no window

wakes.name: a sleeping session coming onto the desk's screen is woken
an awake one is not touched
one already in a pane is NOT woken when another pane changes
the tab coming back wakes what it shows
the first report of a new desk (no previous) wakes its sleeping panes
